title: Not as expected
text:
Not as expected. I actually wanted a pan with enamel inside. Poor product description.
Even in the questions / answers it was misleading !

product_metadata.title: Bruntmor 12'' Black Pre-seasoned Cast Iron Frying Pan, 12 Inch Oven Safe Cast Iron Skillet, Cast Iron Grill Pan Set, Nonstick Cookware And Bakeware For Casserole Dish
features: This large cast iron skillet comes with deep build nonstick design and helps you cook better.

MULTI-USE COOKER PAN: Cast iron helps distribute and heat retention evenly so it can be used to Stir fry, braise, sear, deep fry, bake and more. It works on all cooking ranges such as gas, electric, ceramic, and induction.
STAINLESS STEEL KNOB: This cast iron pan also has a stainless steel knob to make sure that you get a sure grip and dual pouring spouts that makes it an ergonomic design.
OVEN SAFE: Shallow enough for high-heat searing and sautéing yet deep enough for slow-cooking. It can handle the heat up to 500 Degrees Fahrenheit so that you can cook/bake without any fear.
EASY TO CLEAN: The unique design and material makes it very easy to clean. Just use light soap and warm water. It’s quite convenient to use and easily washable.
